description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurses (RNs) to join a leading home health agency in Billings, MT. This is an excellent opportunity for RNs looking for flexibility, with both full-time and part-time positions available, offering a highly competitive salary.

As a Home Health RN, you will provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes, focusing on comprehensive assessments, medication management, wound care, and patient education. You will play a crucial role in promoting patient independence and well-being within a supportive and autonomous work environment.

This role offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to patient care. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of patients and thrive in a dynamic home health setting, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in home health or a related clinical setting
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills
Ability to work independently and manage a patient caseload effectively
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000 based on experience and contract type.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Registered Nurse (RN) to join a dynamic team in Casper, WY. This role offers the opportunity to provide high-quality, compassionate care to patients in the comfort of their own homes, making a significant impact on their well-being and recovery. If you are passionate about patient-centered care and thrive in an autonomous environment, this is an excellent opportunity to advance your career.

As a Home Health RN, you will manage a diverse caseload, performing comprehensive assessments, developing individualized care plans, and administering skilled nursing interventions. This position requires excellent clinical judgment, strong communication skills, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to ensure optimal patient outcomes. Join a supportive environment where your expertise is valued.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Wyoming
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
Minimum of 1-2 years of nursing experience, preferably in home health or acute care
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $45.00, based on experience.

description:
Join a premier medical center in NYC, NY, seeking a skilled Orthopedic Surgeon to provide exceptional care to patients. This role offers a unique opportunity to work within a dynamic environment, focusing on a diverse range of orthopedic conditions and surgical interventions, including those related to Workers' Compensation and No-Fault cases.

We are looking for a dedicated professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality patient outcomes. The compensation package for this position is highly competitive, featuring an attractive annual salary range and a significant emphasis on performance-based bonuses, reflecting our commitment to rewarding excellence.

If you are an experienced Orthopedic Surgeon with a passion for patient care and a desire to make a substantial impact, we encourage you to apply for this full-time position.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) degree from an accredited institution
Current and unrestricted New York State Medical License
Minimum of 5 years of post-residency experience as an Orthopedic Surgeon
Demonstrated experience with Workers' Compensation and No-Fault cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $300,000 - $350,000, with a compensation structure heavily weighted towards performance bonuses.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Physical Therapist (PT) for a PRN opportunity in St. Petersburg, FL. Join a premier health and rehabilitation center committed to providing exceptional patient care. This role offers an attractive hourly rate of $55-$60/hr for immediate placement.

This facility is a well-regarded 55-59 bed center, situated in a vibrant neighborhood with convenient access to shopping and just 15 minutes from the beach. With a current census of 43, you'll be part of a supportive team in a pleasant environment featuring two courtyards. We are looking to fill this position quickly.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Ability to work on a PRN basis
salaryOrBonusInfo: This urgent PRN role offers a competitive hourly rate of $55-$60/hr.
